description:
BiosProfile is a set of BIOS settings that some group of machines should share — authored in git, applying to whichever Hosts match its selector. Several may match one machine; they are layered, and the result of that layering is the machine's BiosSettings, which records which profile each value came from.

Nothing reconciles a BiosProfile directly. It states intent; the settings it produces are what a machine is held against.

fields.name: spec
fields.description: BiosProfileSpec is one layer of desired BIOS configuration for the Hosts it matches. Profiles are git-authored data — no controller reconciles a profile; the convergence reconciler materializes the merged result per host into a BiosSettings object.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Attributes are the BIOS attributes this profile manages, values as the vendor's attribute registry types them (enum string, boolean, integer). An attribute omitted here is unmanaged — a higher layer can override a value but not retract management.

fields.name: layer
fields.description: Layer orders overlapping profiles: materialization merges matched profiles by (layer, name) and a later layer deliberately overrides an earlier one — a role profile (layer 10) over a hardware baseline (layer 0). Two profiles on the SAME layer setting the same attribute to different values are a conflict, and conflict holds the whole materialization.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Match selects Hosts by label. Two label axes exist by construction: intent labels stamped from the bound claim (role: worker — absent on unclaimed machines) and discovered facts (metal.pk.io/vendor, …/model — present regardless of claim state, the axis for hardware baselines).

fields.name: matchExpressions
fields.description: Label requirements that the object must meet. All must match.

fields.name: values
fields.description: The values for In and NotIn. Exists and DoesNotExist take no values.

fields.name: matchLabels
fields.description: Labels that the object must have, as key and value pairs. All must match.
